channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Mohammed Azharuddin Leads Yellow Ribbon Run in Hyderabad to Raise Endometriosis and Women’s Health Awareness
item.description: Minister Mohammed Azharuddin attends Yellow Ribbon Run in Hyderabad, raising awareness about endometriosis and women’s health with over 1,500 participants supporting early diagnosis and treatment.

item.title: Kalvakuntla Kavitha Arrested During Protest in Khammam Over Velugumatla House Demolitions
item.description: Telangana Jagruti president Kalvakuntla Kavitha arrested during protest in Khammam over Velugumatla demolitions, demanding house pattas and Indiramma housing scheme support for displaced families.

item.title: Congress Is the True Custodian of Secularism in India, Says Uttam Kumar Reddy at Suryapet Iftar Gathering
item.description: Minister Uttam Kumar Reddy says Congress is the true custodian of secularism in India while addressing an Iftar gathering in Suryapet, assuring Muslims of protection and welfare.

item.title: Revanth Reddy Inaugurates Restored Nalla Cheruvu in Kukatpally Under HYDRAA, Calls for Lake Restoration Across Hyderabad
item.description: Chief Minister Revanth Reddy inaugurates restored Nalla Cheruvu in Kukatpally under HYDRAA, calling for lake restoration, Musi River rejuvenation, and urban development across Hyderabad.

item.title: HYDRAA Removes Wall Blocking 40-Feet Road at Praneeth Antilia in Mallampet, Travel Distance Reduced by 5 KM
item.description: HYDRAA removes a wall blocking a 40-feet road at Praneeth Antilia in Mallampet, reducing travel distance from 8 km to 3 km for residents traveling between ORR Exit-4, Bachupally, and Pragathi Nagar.

item.title: Israeli military says about 1,900 Iranian soldiers, commanders killed in strikes
item.description: Speaking at a press briefing on Monday, Defrin also confirmed that a second person was killed earlier on Monday in an Iranian missile attack in Israel, bringing the total death toll from Iranian attacks in the country to 12 civilians, in addition to two soldiers killed in combat with Hezbollah militants in Lebanon.

item.title: Kavitha continues indefinite fast after police shifts her to Hyderabad
item.description: Police in Telangana's Khammam town on Tuesday detained Telangana Jagruti president K Kavitha, who has been on an indefinite fast since Monday night, demanding justice for families displaced from a land parcel in the town.

item.title: NCERT Says Sorry Over Controversial Class 8 Chapter on Judiciary Before Supreme Court Hearing
item.description: The National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) on Tuesday tendered an unconditional and unqualified public apology over the controversial chapter referring to corruption in the judiciary in its now-withdrawn Class 8 Social Science textbook.

item.title: Two drivers fighting on road run over by truck in Telangana
item.description: On Monday, Ketamma along with sons went to Bhuvanagiri town to buy stock for her shop. While returning, a speeding van rammed into the auto-rickshaw. While Naresh and Suresh died on the spot, their mother succumbed while being shifted to hospital.

item.title: Shiv Pratap Shukla to take oath as Telangana Governor Wednesday
item.description: As part of the changes, the current Governor of Telangana, Jishnu Dev Varma, has been transferred and appointed as the Governor of Maharashtra. Meanwhile, R. N. Ravi, who has been serving as the Governor of Tamil Nadu, has been appointed as the Governor of West Bengal.
